## ITSessionLockOptions type

Configuration for the distributed session lock.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ITSessionLockOptions = {
    enabled?: boolean;
    leaseMs?: number;
    onContended?: ITSessionLockOnContended;
    key?: (ctx: Ctx) => string;
};
```
**References:** [ITSessionLockOnContended](./gramstax.itsessionlockoncontended.md)<!-- -->, [Ctx](./gramstax.ctx.md)

## Remarks

Redis-only: the lock uses atomic `SET NX PX` leases on the session key so concurrent updates for the same user/chat are serialized or skipped across instances. When the bot's cache is NOT Redis-backed, the feature is auto-disabled with a warning (single-instance deployments do not need it).
